 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Executive Director, I recused myself on August 4, 2022, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding a contract for services in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend, Ms. Rima Berns-McGown.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Executive Director of the Canadian Race Relations Foundation, I recused myself on July 14, 2021, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the hiring of a new Director of Programs and Outreach in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend, Ms. Amira Elghawaby.
